supersedes.reason: The first performance remediation record exposed two independent review false-greens: nonlocal URLs with approved basenames were served as local, and every run replaced rather than enforced the recorded 20% threshold. This record binds the exact-origin denial, immutable committed baseline, and clean requalification results.

outcome: The production Windows desktop shell remains fully qualified and its standard performance gate now denies all nonlocal fixture requests while enforcing both immutable relative p95 thresholds and unchanged absolute latency budgets.

integrationChecks.result: Seven focused tests pass. They retain every nearest-rank sample, enforce absolute and fixed-relative limits independently, reject exact-basename URLs from external/scheme/authority/port/nested/encoded/query variants, reject malformed or override-bearing baselines, preserve governed budgets, and record actionable hardware without host identity.

At exact clean commit 890a8ca, 12 undiscarded repetitions passed the immutable baseline and absolute budgets: cold paint p95 104.000 ms <= 115.200/2500 ms, visible skeleton p95 75.564 ms <= 87.640/150 ms, and usable route p95 80.727 ms <= 93.146/1000 ms. The report binds baseline SHA-256 e85f168b4385a640f73bb6d871424e32d29583282fc741e54cb765bda92bac1a to source commit 6d69c49 and records zero unexpected requests. Report SHA-256: 894eedb87e34785c2ca60bdc9f31119b7b3aa9d2bc54167a2429ec69505d95c9.

At exact clean commit 890a8ca, all 25 commands passed in 483.57 seconds, including 146 foundation tests, 29 desktop tests, 13 renderer tests within the application command, every native command, the immutable performance gate, 32 routes, 139 browser workflow cases, 390 keyboard cases, 64 responsive cases, and 64 visual captures. Report SHA-256: eee36dce44730cdd3cbb5ed8371b56b2edc15b2a0eec03f2aca91e6938c0bee4.
The campaign, three DONE task states and independent approvals, evidence lineage, current S01 remediation state, and generated views validate before resubmission.

integratedBehavior: The production Tauri and React shell remains deterministic, offline, zero-privilege, exact-route, keyboard-operable, visually conformant, and recoverable across all previously approved S01 behavior.

The benchmark serves only exact http://tauri.localhost/index.html and http://tauri.localhost/study-design.html requests; any other scheme, authority, port, path, encoding, query, fragment, or resource request is aborted, retained, and makes the report fail.

The version-controlled baseline is strict-schema validated, pins its originating source commit and fixture/methodology identity, must descend from the current revision, and cannot alter the three approved absolute budgets.

Every current p95 must satisfy both the fixed 120% baseline limit and the absolute plan budget; reports expose both booleans, the baseline file hash, origin commit, full samples, and exact clean current commit.
